title: A Soft Coat for a Too-Warm Loaf
youtube_title: A Soft Coat for a Too-Warm Loaf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small loan of comfort can make a hot walk kinder.
summary: Giorgio's fresh loaf is too hot to hold, so Sable wraps it in an extra cloth and they walk it to the shared table with Emile.
